editorial-research.name: Editorial research
editorial-research.description: Open with supplied findings, mix continuous prose and emphasized evidence, use full-width figures for dense material. No mandatory business outline.

executive-brief.name: Executive brief
executive-brief.description: A metric overview followed by related trend and comparison blocks. Use open prose and wider tables where needed; no required metrics or manufactured deltas.

comparison-review.name: Comparison review
comparison-review.description: Wide common-dimension comparisons with main commentary and quiet supporting notes. Keeps supplied criteria, order, and conclusions.
